name: game_state_field3788_getter
description: Ordinary C++ accessor for the game-state dword at +0x3788. The synthetic caller loads the singleton pointer from the retail global 0x004776F4, which is what puts the pointer in EAX as retail does.

functions.name: GameState_GetField3788
functions.actual_abi: state in EAX; result in EAX; plain RET

context.description: Synthetic caller that establishes the observed register convention; not recovered game code.
